IS 1643 : 2013 : Fire Safety of Buildings (General): Exposure Hazard - Code of PracticeICS 13.220.01CED 36Reaffirmed 20181 SCOPEThis standard covers requirements regarding spacing of buildings to provide adequate safety against exposure hazard.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to invertigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards listed below:1641 : 2013 Fire safety of building (general): General principles of fire grading and classification — Code of practice (second revision)1642 : 2013 Fire safety of buildings (general): Details of construction — Code of practice (second revision)3884 : 1989 Code of practice for installation and maintenance of internal fire hydrants and hose reels on premises9668 : 1990 Code of practice for provision and maintenance of water supplies for fire fighting
